decision: stencil radius m=6 EXCLUDED from the round-2 method; M_CANDIDATES=(1,2,3,4,5)
rule_applied: ROUND2_PROTOCOL.md section 3 -- a radius that does not solve within the stated wall-clock budget is excluded, and the exclusion is recorded before any phantom is run

evidence.m6_failure: spacing 1.2x1x1: TimeoutError after 900 s at cutting-plane iteration 80 (first attempt: 600 s, 40 iterations)

reason_for_global_cap: production encounters voxel spacings not in this table and must solve the LP at measurement time; a radius that can fail to converge for some ratio cannot be guaranteed for an unseen one, so the exclusion is global rather than a per-spacing table
consequence: the a-priori budget is marginally larger for well-resolved objects at anisotropic spacing, where m=6 would otherwise have been selected; quantified in out/m6_sensitivity.md
not_done: the cap was NOT chosen to save compute, and was NOT lowered after seeing any phantom result
